data.one_liner: An extensible logger for printing formatted logs with levels, custom filters, and printers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Logger instance that prints formatted logs with configurable log levels, filters, printers, and outputs. Supports custom options such as pretty-printing with colors, emojis, method counts, and timestamps.
use_when: You need detailed and formatted console logs during development
You want to filter logs based on severity or application state
You require custom outputs like file logging or streams alongside console output
avoid_when: You need a full production crash-reporting and remote analytics solution
You want zero-dependency lightweight logging without formatting overhead
strengths: Extensible architecture with custom filters, printers, and outputs
Pretty printing with colors, emojis, and stack traces out of the box
Supports multiple log levels including trace, debug, info, warning, error, and fatal
weaknesses: Requires manual setup and handling if you want persistent file logs in production
ANSI color escape sequences may have issues on certain macOS environments

alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative advanced logger with customizable formatters and settings.
